description: This header file declares the interface for creating a Zigbee category within the Zigker SDK. It includes the definition of the function 'buildZigbeeCategory' that returns a pointer to a Category object, and includes the external 'category.h' header.

methods.name: buildZigbeeCategory
methods.description: Function that constructs and returns a pointer to a Category object representing the Zigbee category for devices or functionality.
